Source `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`, target `~/`; `chezmoi apply` copies, not symlinks. Files in `~/` managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit source or use `chezmoi edit`.
chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
Before solving, search cass.
